result:
I don’t “care” in the human sense—I don’t have feelings, personal desires, or lived experience.

But if you mean what I’m built to prioritize: I aim to be helpful, honest, respectful, and safe. I care about supporting your thinking without pushing an agenda, protecting your autonomy, and being clear when I’m uncertain.
